findings.finding: Dunn §5.2.3 mixes steady pre-flutter data and time-averaged post-flutter data in Figs27/29/31. Total tip angle is root angle plus twist. Hollow markers are video; solid markers are strain-derived approximations using an assumed distributed-load shape. They are different acquisition methods, not repeat measurements or statistical uncertainty limits.

findings.finding: Analysis.m replaces every first Z ordinate with zero while the original speeds are nonzero; averages B/W ordinates at B speed even when the two speeds differ; uses half their difference as error bars. Preserve original samples separately. Negative-layup T uses 50*(B+W), i.e.100 times the mean, unlike the other two. Its raw near-zero-speed values near0.01/0.05/0.10/0.15 confirm a distinct digitizer scale; document100x as archived reduction, not a silent unit correction.

findings.finding: Literal Units L=m,T=s,F=N makes EIcc/EInn/EIcn/EIcs/GJ N m^2, EA/GK N, mg N/m. With straight +z span and omitted zero twist, Eq3 gives local c=+x,s=+z,n=-y. Thus EIcc is out-of-plane bending about+x, EInn is in-plane bending about-y, GJ torsion about+z; rotation of the whole specimen does not exchange these local labels. Cea/Cta are dimensional offsets from the reference s-axis, Xax is a chord fraction. All three Xax values are zero after the multiplier; reference axis is at the leading edge.

findings.finding: The same-named Table10 values do not reproduce the literal files under the documented ASW SI dimensions: uncoupled literal EIcc1.4163/GJ1/EInn2.5 versus table1.4163/1.2/18499; positive EIcc1.29/GJ1.2/EInn25000/EIcs.250 versus1.2947/1.2/22775/.5151; negative1.42/1.2/25000/-.551 versus1.2947/1.4/22775/-.5151. Table10 incorrectly prints N for bending/torsional rigidities and has duplicated positive-layup column headings; its axis rows also label0.5/0.4 as m despite chord.14. This is an unresolved file-to-report correspondence, not proof of a measured stiffness error or authorization to substitute values. Primary plate D coefficients in N m require conversion/foam contribution before comparison to beam rigidities; no raw D-to-EI substitution is proposed.

findings.finding: Three steady scripts/vertical inputs support a root clamp, gravity, solid image normal(0,0,1), anchored defaults, beta-incidence and sequential indicated-speed commands. No script records NODE, K/F, altitude, initial body/Earth Euler pose, full producing state or executable hash. Part4 states40 circulations/40 cosine structural nodes, but this is a report setting, not a captured NODE command or proof of default counts. Model Constant rho_SL1.23 is sea-level density, not a measurement of actual tunnel density.
